RAJYA SABHA
Friday, the 1st February, 2019/12 Magha, 1940 (Saka)
The House met at one of the clock,  
MR. CHAIRMAN  in the Chair.
THE INTERIM BUDGET, 2019-20
MR. CHAIRMAN: The Interim Budget, 2019-20; Shri Piyush Goyal.
THE MINISTER OF FINANCE (SHRI PIYUSH GOYAL): Sir, I lay on the 
Table, a statement (in English and Hindi) of the estimated receipts and expenditure 
of the Government, for the year 2019-20.
[Placed in Library. See No. L.T. 10776/16/19]
FISCAL POLICY STATEMENTS, 2019-20
MR. CHAIRMAN: Fiscal Policy Statements, 2019-20; Shri Piyush Goyal.
THE MINISTER OF FINANCE (SHRI PIYUSH GOYAL): Sir, I lay on the 
Table, under sub-section (1) of Section 3 of the Fiscal Responsibility and Budget 
Management Act, 2003, a copy each (in English and Hindi) of the following papers:-
(i) Medium-term Fiscal Policy-cum-Fiscal Policy Strategy Statement;
(ii) Macro-Economic Framework Statement.
[Placed in Library. See No. L.T. 10777/16/19]
MOTION FOR EXTENSION OF TIME FOR PRESENTATION OF THE 
REPORT OF THE SELECT COMMITTEE ON THE ANCIENT 
MONUMENTS AND ARCHAEOLOGICAL SITES AND 
REMAINS (AMENDMENT) BILL, 2018 
DR. VINAY P. SAHASRABUDDHE (Maharashtra): Sir, I move:
 "That the time appointed for presentation of Report of the Select Committee on 

2 Motion for Extension... [RAJYA SABHA] ...(Amendment) Bill, 2018
the Ancient Monuments and Archaeological Sites and Remains (Amendment) 
Bill, 2018, be extended till 8th February, 2019."
The question was put and the motion was adopted.
MR. CHAIRMAN: The House stands adjourned till 11.00 a.m. on Monday, the 
4th February, 2019. 
The House then adjourned at two minutes past 
one of the clock till eleven of the clock on 
Monday, the 4th February, 2019.
